definitions.explanation: A premium brand of wagyu beef raised under strict standards in and around Matsusaka, Mie Prefecture. Prized for its fine, dense marbling and buttery texture, it commands very high prices.

examples.japanese: {松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This restaurant is famous for its Matsusaka beef.

examples.japanese: {松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{霜降|しもふ}り→霜降り：18934_shimofuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧、⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧な⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Matsusaka beef is known as a high-grade beef with beautiful marbling.

notes:
{松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう} is a brand of ⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧ (wagyu) raised under strict feeding and pedigree standards in the Matsusaka area of Mie Prefecture. It is known for its fine, dense marbling (⟦{霜降|しもふ}り→霜降り：18934_shimofuri⟧) and very tender, buttery texture.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{霜降|しもふ}り→霜降り：18934_shimofuri⟧: the marbling of Matsusaka beef
- {松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ステーキ: Matsusaka beef steak
- {松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧: the beef's place of origin

CULTURAL NOTE:
{松阪牛|まつさかぎゅう} is traditionally counted, along with ⟦{神戸牛|こうべぎゅう}→神戸牛：30922_koubegyuu⟧ (Kobe beef) and {近江牛|おうみぎゅう} (Omi beef), among Japan's "three great wagyu brands" ({三大和牛|さんだいわぎゅう}). Restaurants and gift boxes often display the specific brand name prominently to signal quality and justify the high price.
